name: Icee Keyring Arcade
summary: Cool off with some classic gaming! The ICEE Keyring Arcade puts retro arcade action in the palm of your hand. Play as the iconic ICEE Bear, surfing through a frozen world as you collect as many ICEE cups as you can while dodging falling snowflakes and spiky icicles. Move up and down with the directional buttons and press the fire button to launch snowballs and blast obstacles out of your path! Score big by grabbing cups and smashing through the chill. Compact and keyring-ready, it’s the perfect on-the-go game for ICEE lovers, retro fans, and anyone who enjoys cool vibes with their high scores.
